## About
Ross Auto Body Shop is a family shop in Miami. Joaquin Ross and his family focus on auto body repair, and as the shop puts it, no work is too big or small.
Our team looks over your vehicle and works to get the job done on time and at your convenience. We speak English and Spanish, so you can talk to us in whichever you prefer.
Customers rate the shop 5 stars across 147 Google reviews. One reviewer said the shop sent pictures while the car was being worked on, and another said the team helped with their insurance claim from start to finish.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Dents, accident damage and body work, from small fixes to bigger jobs.
- Repair and paint: One customer brought in his truck after an accident and praised the repair and paint work.
- Free towing: Free towing around the clock when your vehicle is repaired at our facility.
- Estimates: Ask us for an estimate on your repair before any work begins.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer a warranty?
A: Yes. The shop offers a 3-year warranty when your vehicle is repaired at our facility.

Q: Is towing really free?
A: Yes, towing is free, any time of day, as long as the vehicle is repaired at our facility.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Give us a call at 786-803-8245 and we will set up a time that works for you.
